name: Sternum
description: Flat bone forming the anterior midline of the thoracic wall. Three parts: manubrium, body, and xiphoid process. The sternal angle (angle of Louis) at the manubriosternal junction marks the level of T4–T5, the aortic arch, and the carina. On CT: assess for fractures, sternal wires (post-sternotomy), and retrosternal masses.
